signal: PrimePay completed a strategic merger with CoAdvantage and rolled out the ProfitKeeper franchise analytics platform

email.body1:
Toni, saw PrimePay merged with CoAdvantage and is rolling out ProfitKeeper, widening what reps need to carry.

A merger plus a new platform usually means reps spend ramp time on research and enablement instead of in front of buyers, and pipeline lags. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PrimePay off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Toni, quick follow-up for PrimePay.

When two teams combine, the number usually outpaces how fast reps can ramp on the joint offering. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings each rep needs, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PrimePay needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Toni, last bit of proof for PrimePay.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PrimePay's reply rate likely compares to other HCM teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Toni, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline through the merger without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Combining two GTM teams is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a post-merger motion? I will tailor it to PrimePay either way.
